text:
nina: Heads-up — planning a coordinated base-image rebuild next week. Main goals: reduce runtime privileges, enforce signed images with short-lived signer creds, and make KMS usage fully auditable.
maria: sounds good. propose a canary at 2026-04-20 01:30 UTC, full staggered rollout over 2 hours.
kevin: +1. I'll enumerate current image publishers and owners. Also plan to bake `org.build.id` and `org.rebuild.ts` labels into images.
drew: for RBAC, i'd like builder-SA reduced to only what it's using today (no registry push perms except for build-service role). Signer should get asymmetricSign only, for a constrained key. We should avoid granting any get/list key permissions to CI masters.
nina: exactly. requirement: signer tokens minted via STS with TTL 15m, logged. Jenkins/GHA must not hold long-lived access to signing key.
ops-bot: creating log sinks: 1) image-events -> gs://audit-images-24mo (retention=24mo) 2) kms-usage -> gs://audit-kms-13mo (retention=13mo). Setting Pub/Sub alert for unexpected principals.
kms-bot: key prepared: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuildKR/cryptoKeys/rebuild-0426. Binding will restrict cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign to serviceAccount:signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com only.
kevin: can we add attestation predicate schema to the runbook? e.g., fields: build_id, git_ref, builder_sa, base_image_digest, layer_digests. we'll need that for SCA correlation.
maria: yes. add that and make ATTEST a required CI gate for prod images.
drew: emergency revoke checklist (short): 1) remove signer IAM binding 2) disable key version 3) suspend signer SA 4) block registry pushes from signer token. commands: ```
# remove binding
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding rebuild-0426 --keyring=rebuildKR --location=global \
  --member="serviceAccount:signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
# disable key version
gcloud kms keys versions destroy 1 --key=rebuild-0426 --keyring=rebuildKR --location=global
# disable SA
gcloud iam service-accounts disable signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
kevin: monitoring: add an alert for any AsymmetricSign calls from principals outside the allowlist. Also alert on image push without an attestation.
nina: for canary diagnostics keep these handy: `kubectl -n canary get pods -o wide`, `kubectl -n canary describe pod <pod>`, `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricSign" --limit 50`, `cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuildKR/cryptoKeys/rebuild-0426 $IMAGE`.
maria: vuln triage rota: nina primary (kernel/host), kevin secondary (container deps). we'll label issues with `vuln-triage` and run a post-rollout sweep at +24h.
drew: retention Q: compliance wants 13 months for KMS and 24 months for image events. ops-bot — confirm sinks will map to separate buckets?
ops-bot: confirmed: separate buckets as requested. will also forward filtered KMS usage to SIEM for longer retention/analysis.
kevin: plan to run a staging end-to-end this week: sign with KMS key, verify predicate parsing, and trigger the alert with a fake principal to validate SIEM flow.
maria: one more: include immutable label `org.build.id` baked into image so we can trace registry events back to git commit. No mutable tag reliance.
nina: action items: 1) kevin: owner map + staging dry-run (due 2026-04-16) 2) drew: RBAC policy + revoke playbook (due 2026-04-17) 3) ops-bot: create sinks + SIEM forward (due 2026-04-18) 4) maria: update runbook + add attestation schema (due 2026-04-18).
kevin: adding a small diagnostic snippet to run during triage: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND labels.k8s-pod/app=canary" --freshness=1h --format="json(payload)"`
maria: ok let's keep the window tight and no other infra changes during the canary. ops-bot, schedule maintenance for IAM/keys?
ops-bot: maintenance window scheduled 2026-04-20T00:30:00Z -> 2026-04-20T03:00:00Z for IAM/key updates. infra-oncall notified.
nina: thanks all. i'll fold these into the runbook and ping again before the rollout. :white_check_mark:
